SENEA’s economic moat is primarily built on scale, supply chain integration, and dual-channel distribution (private-label wholesale plus branded Green Giant products). The durability of this moat is inherently constrained by the agricultural nature of its business: pronounced seasonal fluctuations in production and working capital requirements create cyclical pressure on liquidity and margins [7].
